sections.normalized_html:
The common logarithm of [MATH: a] is defined as follows:

[MATH: a = 10^x] is equivalent to [MATH: \log{a} = x]

If we compare [MATH: 10^3 = 1\,000] with [MATH: 10^x = a,] we get that [MATH: a = 1\,000] and [MATH: x = 3.]

Therefore, the given equation can be expressed as [MATH: \log{1\,000} = 3.]

sections.normalized_html:
